authorization: a sufficient storage preflight is a measurement only: it accepts no gate, authorizes no acquisition, and changes no ticket state

cohort.role: coefficient measurement only; never acquisition credit

coinalyze.equation: gross_required_raw_bytes - retained_raw_bytes = projected_new_raw_bytes; retained coverage is credited by its own proved points and framing, never by a bare byte subtraction

identity_map.derivation: none; the retained provider/native pair is the only authority

coinalyze.identity_namespaces: supported mappings, lifecycles, projection groups, and partition keys are Binance-native; retained API series are Coinalyze provider identity
coinalyze.request_framing: one symbol per request; no unproved batching credit
coinalyze.semantics: observed and censored liquidation aggregate, never complete

count_sources.physical_raw_objects: manifest detail rows plus accepted cost keys
count_sources.projected_coinalyze_receipts: one liquidation receipt per supported mapping plus one inventory

filesystem.accounting: retained evidence and the durable receipt are already charged against post-publication availability and are never added again

partitioning.rule: one file per logical product, symbol, UTC month, and source family

retained_credit.source: effective checkpoint rows inside the complete selected-plus-cost requirement, path-bound, rehashed, and deduplicated by content digest

projections.arithmetic: integer cross multiplication and ceiling division only

families.ceiling_operation: sum over symbol-month groups of ceil(group_bytes * numerator / denominator) * multiplicity
families.largest_partition_rule: one logical output file, before fan-out
families.ratio_selection: greatest exact rational by cross multiplication
